summary: Round r1 (restricted network). The question is how Chinese outward lending and investment trends affect Nepal's financing options. Research design: compare (a) Chinese official outward FDI to Nepal (MOFCOM OFDI bulletin, host-country NRB FDI survey and DoI/IBN approvals), (b) Chinese official lending to Nepal (World Bank IDS creditor lines, PDMO debt statistics, MoF DCR) and (b') independent project-level datasets (AidData, academic hidden-debt literature), and (c) the policy framework (BRI Framework for Cooperation, grant-versus-loan terms). The session web-search budget was exhausted before China-specific searches ran; only Nepal MoF/PDMO documents located for other subagents and catalog endpoints are recorded as leads. No values retrieved; all empirical items pending.

findings.claim: Chinese outward FDI flows and stock in Nepal by year (MOFCOM/NBS/SAFE bulletin) versus NRB-recorded FDI from China and DoI/IBN approvals from Chinese investors.
findings.note: Three methodologies (source-country BoP, host-country survey, approvals) must be reported separately; MOFCOM is calendar year, NRB is Nepal FY.

findings.claim: Chinese official lending to Nepal: disbursed and outstanding PPG debt owed to China (bilateral and China EXIM), terms (interest, maturity, grace) and share of external debt.
findings.note: IDS creditor tables (calendar year) and PDMO/MTDS (Nepal FY); leads 18B-L02, L05.

findings.claim: China grants and loans committed vs disbursed to Nepal per MoF Development Cooperation Reports.
findings.note: Leads 18B-L03, L04; DCR tables by development partner.

findings.claim: Global trend in Chinese overseas development lending (commitments by year and region; shift from project lending to rescue lending/grants) from independent datasets.
findings.note: AidData Global Chinese Development Finance dataset and peer-reviewed work on Chinese overseas lending (e.g. Horn, Reinhart and Trebesch on China's overseas lending) - documents not located in r1 (search budget exhausted); citations to be verified.

findings.claim: Documented terms of the Nepal-China BRI Framework for Cooperation and any project-level financing agreements (grant vs loan modality).
findings.note: Primary MoFA Nepal / MOFCOM texts not located in r1; required: signed framework text, date, and any financing annex.

findings.claim: Nepal's financing options are affected through three channels: volume/terms of Chinese official credit, Chinese FDI in hydropower/infrastructure/manufacturing, and Chinese grant aid; each is recorded separately and enters the model only via external_financing (X22) or FDI variables.
No statement is made about Chinese government intentions; only documented agreements, disbursements and published datasets are used.

data_gaps: Session WebSearch budget was exhausted before searches for this subagent could be run; Crossref/doi.org are blocked by the egress proxy. Leads marked 'catalog endpoint' are the unverified catalog URLs in research/sources/source_catalog.yaml, not search-located documents.
MOFCOM OFDI Statistical Bulletin document URL not located.
AidData Chinese development finance dataset and Nepal records not located.
Nepal-China BRI Framework for Cooperation text not located.
China GACC customs data on trade with Nepal lacks a catalog id (raised by 16A).
Peer-reviewed references on Chinese overseas lending not bibliographically verified.

assumptions.text: Source-country (MOFCOM), host-country (NRB) and approval (DoI/IBN) FDI measures are kept separate.
Chinese lending affects Nepal through external_financing; FDI affects investment; grants affect fiscal grants - no double counting.

challenges.text: X22 lists 18B only as support; Chinese lending trend data (IDS creditor lines, AidData) should be explicitly assigned to 18B as supplier of the China creditor sub-series.
Source catalog lacks an AidData id; add it (tier 7, independent dataset) so Chinese project-level finance leads can carry a source_id.
Reconcile PDMO China creditor lines with World Bank IDS; differences in coverage (SOE/guaranteed debt) and period basis must be documented, not averaged.

uncertainty: Very high. No China-specific primary document was located in r1 because the search budget was exhausted; catalog endpoints are unverified. Chinese lending data are known to have coverage gaps in official statistics, so independent datasets will be needed and will disagree with official ones.

financing_trend_notes.method: Build three parallel series (OFDI to Nepal: MOFCOM vs NRB vs DoI/IBN; official lending: IDS vs PDMO vs AidData; grants: DCR) with period basis stated; describe global Chinese lending trend from AidData/peer-reviewed sources; map to Nepal financing options (concessional debt, FDI, grants).

notes.required: AidData dataset and peer-reviewed literature, to be located in r2
signed text from MoFA Nepal or MOFCOM
